relations.rationale: Deagel describes S-400M as a prospective upgraded S-400 variant with an unofficial designation. The relation retains that qualification and does not claim fielding or operational status.

evidence.quote: The S-400M (unofficial designation) is a prospective upgraded variant of the S-400 air defense system expected to include longer range engagement capabilities against airborne targets and hypersonic missiles.
The S-400 entered service with the Russian Armed Forces on April 28, 2007, replacing the S-300 air defense system.
